title: The Tyranny of the Rocket Equation
description: Calculate fuel for spacecraft modules, then recursively account for the fuel's own mass.
writeup:
## Approach

The classic rocket equation problem: fuel has mass, which needs more fuel.

## Part 1

Direct formula: `fuel = mass // 3 - 2` for each module. Sum them all up.

## Part 2

Iteratively apply the fuel formula to the fuel itself until the result is zero or negative. Each module produces a chain of decreasing fuel amounts — for a mass of 100756, the chain is 33583, 11192, 3728, 1240, 411, 135, 43, 12, 2. The total is about 50% more than Part 1's naive calculation, illustrating why the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation makes space travel so expensive.
